t: Is Craftsy worth it? | Knitting and Crochet Forum
s: The old craftsy, where you could watch videos for free, but others were pay for use, and buy yarn, was great. Then, they became bluprint and started charging if you wanted to watch or learn anything. Then, I saw that they had gone back to the Craftsy name. A few years back, I tried the subscription offer for a year (the dirt cheap one, which was one or two dollars), in case they'd gone back to the old way of doing business.
